questions: How exactly do WSTS, Gartner, Omdia, TechInsights and IDC define and compute the semiconductor market (reporting population, estimation for non-members, product scope)?
How are foundry revenue, captive/custom chips (e.g. hyperscaler ASICs, Apple silicon), distribution resale and systems revenue (e.g. Nvidia systems) treated by each publisher?
Why did Gartner's 2024 estimate move from US$626bn to US$655.9bn, and how large are typical revisions?
Why do WSTS and Gartner annual totals differ for the same year (2019-2025), and which should the atlas use as the reference?
What is 'region of sale' in WSTS and how does it differ from company-HQ or production location?
subquestions: Does WSTS publish its member list and the share of the market that is estimated?
Do any publishers count chips at transfer value inside IDMs or systems companies?
primary_sources: WSTS 'About WSTS' and membership presentation (e.g. WSTS-Presentation-Membership-Jan2026, wsts.org)
WSTS Historical Billings Report notes (wsts.org)
SIA Factbook 2025 methodology notes
Gartner semiconductor revenue press releases (e.g. 12 January 2026) and methodology notes
open_questions: Output feeds 'Global chip market time series 1986-2026' and every competition unit.

questions: What are the pure-play, total foundry and 'Foundry 2.0' (TSMC's definition incl. packaging, test, masks and non-memory IDM manufacturing) market sizes 2020-2025?
Who are the top 10 foundries and their shares under each definition (TSMC, Samsung Foundry, SMIC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, Hua Hong, Tower, VIS, PSMC, Nexchip, Intel Foundry)?
What are foundry shares by node band (leading-edge, 7-16nm, 28nm and above) and by region of fab?
How fast have Chinese foundries grown in share since 2019, and at which nodes?
How do analyst (TrendForce, Counterpoint) share figures compare with company-reported revenue?
subquestions: How does TSMC define Foundry 2.0 in its 2024-2025 reports, and how much larger is it?
How should Samsung Foundry's and Intel Foundry's internal revenue be treated?
primary_sources: TSMC annual report and quarterly management reports (Foundry 2.0 definition)
UMC, GlobalFoundries (20-F), SMIC, Hua Hong, Tower, VIS, PSMC annual reports
Intel 10-K Intel Foundry segment disclosures
Samsung Electronics business report (DART) foundry disclosures
secondary_sources: TrendForce quarterly foundry ranking press releases
open_questions: Foundry business model and transfer pricing are RU-0091; this unit is size and shares.

questions: How did the revenue share of fabless firms, foundries and IDMs evolve from 1990 to 2025 (GSA/SIA/TechInsights series)?

When and why did the fabless model emerge (first fabless firms in the 1980s, the Fabless Semiconductor Association in 1994) and what made it viable (TSMC's pure-play model, MOSIS/multi-project wafers, EDA)?
When were EDA (Daisy/Mentor/Valid, then Cadence and Synopsys) and IP licensing (Arm 1990, Rambus, MIPS) spun out as separate businesses, and how did they grow?
When and why did assembly/test (OSAT) move offshore and become independent (ASE, Amkor, SPIL)?
Which IDMs went fab-lite or fabless (AMD/GlobalFoundries 2009, TI, LSI, Motorola/Freescale), when and why?
subquestions: What share of chip revenue was fabless in 2000, 2010, 2020, 2025?
What did the Mead-Conway (1980) design methodology contribute?
primary_sources: Company 10-K/20-F filings and prospectuses (TSMC, UMC, AMD, Qualcomm, Nvidia, ASE, Arm, Synopsys, Cadence)
GSA (formerly FSA) publications and history
SIA factbooks
AMD 2009 GlobalFoundries separation filings
secondary_sources: Academic histories of the foundry model (e.g. Brown and Linden 'Chips and Change')
open_questions: Rising capital intensity and exits from the leading edge are in RU-0116; technology history in RU-0079; pre-2018 policy in RU-0151.

questions: What were Japan's shares of the total market by year and product (esp. DRAM) from 1975 to 2015?
What was the VLSI Technology Research Association project (1976-1980), how was it funded and what did it deliver?
How did the 1986 and 1991 US-Japan semiconductor agreements affect Japanese firms' prices and shares?
Why did Japanese makers lose DRAM to Korea and how were remaining businesses consolidated (Elpida 1999, Renesas 2003/2010, Toshiba memory to Kioxia 2018)?
What roles did Japan keep (equipment, materials, image sensors, power) and why?
primary_sources: METI/MITI documents and white papers (to verify availability)
WSTS/SIA historical data
Elpida reorganisation filings; Renesas and Kioxia prospectuses
SEAJ historical equipment statistics

questions: Which system companies design their own chips (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Meta, Apple, Tesla, Huawei, Xiaomi, OpenAI) and for which uses?
Which firms provide ASIC/turnkey services (Broadcom, Marvell, GUC, Alchip, MediaTek, Socionext) and which system companies does each serve (as disclosed)?
How are these firms tied to foundries (e.g. TSMC's ~35% stake in GUC) and to packaging capacity?
How large is custom silicon by revenue and wafer volume, and how is it counted in market statistics (captive chips are excluded from vendor rankings)?

Broadcom and Marvell 10-K/10-Q (custom silicon disclosures)

TSMC Open Innovation Platform pages; TSMC annual report (GUC shareholding)
